properties.name: Adana

cluesEasy: The capital of the Republic of Turkey.

cluesEasy: Known as the tourism capital of Turkey.

cluesEasy: Famous for Borçka Karagöl and the Şavşat highlands.

Has fertile plains in the Yeşilırmak basin.

properties.name: Trabzon
cluesEasy: Sümela Monastery clings to a steep cliff face.
The natural wonder of Uzungöl lies within this province.
Identified with anchovy, kuymak and horon dance culture.

Was one of the busiest Black Sea ports of the historic Silk Road.
Boztepe offers panoramic views of the city and the sea.

properties.name: Tunceli
cluesEasy: Famous for Munzur Valley National Park and its springs.

Pertek Castle stands on an island in Keban Dam Lake.

Pülümür Valley and the Munzur Stream have rafting routes.
Its red-spotted trout is an endemic treasure of the region.
properties.extraClue: Located between Elazığ, Erzincan and Bingöl.

properties.name: Şanlıurfa
cluesEasy: Göbeklitepe, the oldest temple in human history, is here.
Balıklıgöl is the city's best-known visiting spot.
Famous for çiğ köfte, isot pepper and sıra nights.
cluesHard: The conical-domed mudbrick houses of Harran lie in its southern plain.
The minaret of Halfeti's submerged mosque rises from the Euphrates.
Throughout history called the 'City of Prophets'.

properties.name: Uşak
cluesEasy: Ulubey Canyon, the world's second-largest canyon, is here.
The Karun Treasure is displayed in the Archaeology Museum in this province.
Famous for tarhana and hand-woven carpets.

Clandras Bridge is a historic structure from the Phrygian era.
In the inner Aegean, on the İzmir–Ankara highway.
properties.extraClue: Located between Manisa, Afyonkarahisar and Denizli.

properties.name: Van
cluesEasy: Gives its name to Turkey's largest lake.
World-famous for its cat with differently coloured eyes.
Famous for its rich breakfast and herbed cheese.
cluesHard: Akdamar Island and its historic church lie on the lake's south.
Tushpa, capital of the Urartian Kingdom, was founded here.
Muradiye Waterfall lies in the province's northeast.

properties.name: Yozgat
cluesEasy: Famous for testi kebab and arabaşı soup.
Çamlık National Park, Turkey's first national park, is here.
The historic Clock Tower is a symbol of the city square.
cluesHard: The Roman Bath (Basilica Therma) in Sarıkaya is an ancient thermal complex.
Set on the Bozok Plateau of Central Anatolia.
The Çapanoğlu Mosque is an example of Baroque-influenced Ottoman architecture.
properties.extraClue: East of Ankara, between Kırıkkale and Sivas.

properties.name: Zonguldak
cluesEasy: The capital of Turkey's hard coal mining.

The first settlement made a province after the Republic was proclaimed.
properties.extraClue: On the Western Black Sea coast, between Bartın and Düzce.

properties.name: Aksaray
cluesEasy: Ihlara Valley lies within this province.
Mount Hasan rises as a majestic volcano south of the city.
Known for the Malaklı shepherd dog.
cluesHard: Sultanhanı Caravanserai is Anatolia's largest Seljuk inn.
The Crooked Minaret (Eğri Minare) is the city centre's best-known historic structure.
Located on the southeastern shore of Lake Tuz.
properties.extraClue: Located between Konya and Nevşehir.

properties.name: Bayburt
cluesEasy: The Baksı Museum blends contemporary art and traditional culture.
The Çoruh River winds through the city centre.
One of Turkey's least populated provinces.
cluesHard: The Dede Korkut Culture and Art Festivals are held here every year.
Known for the Aydıntepe Underground City and its historic castle.
A pass between Erzurum and Gümüşhane/Trabzon.

properties.name: Karaman
cluesEasy: The city where Karamanoğlu Mehmet Bey declared Turkish the official language.
A leading Turkish centre for biscuit and wafer production.
Known for the Taşkale Granaries carved into rock.
cluesHard: The ruins of Binbir Kilise (Thousand and One Churches) lie at the foot of Karadağ.
Mentioned as one of the places holding the tomb of Yunus Emre.
South of Konya, at the northern foot of the Taurus Mountains.
properties.extraClue: Located between Konya and Mersin.

properties.name: Kırıkkale
cluesEasy: Known for the defence industry (MKE) and an oil refinery.

The immediate eastern neighbour of Ankara.
cluesHard: A strategic junction on the road route of 43 provinces.

Çeşnigir Bridge is a historic Seljuk-era bridge.

cluesEasy: The historic settlement of Hasankeyf lies within this province.

The Tigris River flows through the south of the province.
cluesHard: The eastern end of the Malabadi Bridge borders this province.
Stands out for its young population and modern urban planning.
Located between Diyarbakır, Siirt and Mardin.
properties.extraClue: A Southeastern province founded around an oil refinery.

cluesEasy: Mount Cudi and the Habur Border Gate lie within this province.
The Cizre district is a historic centre on the Tigris.
Borders Iraq and Syria.
cluesHard: The land where the renowned scholar Al-Jazari lived.
Kasrik Gorge and the Finik archaeological site hold historic ruins.
One of the easternmost provinces of Southeastern Anatolia.
properties.extraClue: Neighbours Mardin, Siirt and Hakkari.

properties.name: Bartın
cluesEasy: The Amasra district is world-famous for its castle and salad.
The Bartın Stream, navigable by ships, is here.

cluesHard: İnkumu Beach is among the longest shores of the Western Black Sea.
The Güzelcehisar Lava Columns are a natural formation millions of years old.
Located between Zonguldak and Kastamonu.

properties.name: Ardahan
cluesEasy: Most of Lake Çıldır lies within this province.
Known for kashar cheese, flower honey and the Damal doll.

The Türkgözü and Aktaş border gates with Georgia are here.
A high-plateau province in the far northeast of Eastern Anatolia.
properties.extraClue: Located between Kars and Artvin.

properties.name: Iğdır
cluesEasy: Known as the Çukurova of the East; apricots and cotton grow here.
The city where Mount Ağrı appears clearest and most majestic.
Borders three countries (Armenia, Nakhchivan/Azerbaijan, Iran).
cluesHard: Turkey's easternmost point, the Dilucu Border Gate, is in this province.
The Tuzluca Salt Caves are visited for health tourism.
Thanks to its microclimate, it is much milder than its surroundings.
properties.extraClue: The only province in Turkey bordering 3 different countries.

properties.name: Yalova
cluesEasy: Thermal springs and Atatürk's Walking Pavilion are here.
Turkey's smallest province by area.
On the Marmara Sea coast, very close to İstanbul by ferry.
cluesHard: Sudüşen Waterfall and Karaca Arboretum are important natural areas.
The Çınarcık district is known for summer-holiday tourism.
Has land borders with Kocaeli and Bursa.
properties.extraClue: Its plate code is 77.

properties.name: Karabük
cluesEasy: The UNESCO World Heritage Safranbolu houses lie within this province.
Turkey's first iron and steel factory (KARDEMİR) was founded here.
Famous for saffron and Turkish delight.
cluesHard: The Crystal Glass Terrace and Tokatlı Canyon are popular sights.
Yenice Forests have been named a biodiversity 'hot spot'.
Located inland in the Western Black Sea.
properties.extraClue: Neighbours Zonguldak, Bartın and Kastamonu.

properties.name: Kilis

The Öncüpınar Border Gate with Syria is here.
Located just south of Gaziantep.
cluesHard: Ravanda Castle and Oylum Mound are important archaeological sites.
Stands out for its historic stone mansions and narrow streets.
A small-area border province strong in grape and olive production.

properties.name: Osmaniye
cluesEasy: Turkey's capital of peanut production.
Karatepe-Aslantaş Open-Air Museum is here.

cluesHard: The ancient city of Kastabala (Hierapolis) is known for its colonnaded street.

Zorkun Plateau is a favourite for cooling off in summer.
properties.extraClue: Its plate code is 80.

cluesEasy: The 81st and most recent province of Turkey.

Lake Efteni and Güzeldere Waterfall are natural wonders.
